set -eu
sudo install -d -m 0750 /srv/data/config /srv/data/records
printf '%s\n' 'mode=production' 'feature_snapshots=enabled' | sudo tee /srv/data/config/app.conf >/dev/null
printf '%s\n' 'record-001:alpha' 'record-002:beta' | sudo tee /srv/data/records/application.db >/dev/null

SNAP=/mnt/srv-data-top/snapshots/before-change
